title: Amazon and Apple Deliver the Drama to Close a Turbulent Month
summary: A surge in  Amazon  stock Friday gave the Nasdaq enough momentum to obscure  Apple  slump.  Beneath the surface of the Nasdaq composite’s 1% gain was a tug of war between Apple stock, which fell 7.4%, and Amazon’s which surged 15%.  The post-earnings slide, Apple’s largest since 2014, followed company forecasts for its September quarter that fell short of Wall Street’s expectations.
